follow-up time: Through the second trimester and/or at the time of pregnancy outcome
exposure: Cell-based quadrivalent inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV4c; Flucelvax Quad)
cohort: This study included 665 pregnant persons immunized with IIV4c as part of routine care.
finding: The prevalence of adverse pregnancy outcomes or preterm birth, low birth weight, or MCMs in newborns was similar in those vaccinated with IIV4c compared to rates observed in US surveillance systems.
gest_age: Preterm birth defined as <37 weeks gestational age
birth_weight: Low birth weight defined as <2500 g
